title: The Briefing Nobody Heard
description: EASTER EGG (struktured, 2026-11-11). The party beat the Cave Rat King without ever speaking to Elder Theron. On their first return to Harmonia he is in the square rehearsing the briefing he never got to give; they are already holding the Rat King's crown. It REPLACES world1_chapter1 for that save: he concedes the lesson, hands the whole party manual control, and offers the skipped trials as optional sparring. He is put out and privately impressed; the speedrunner is teased, never scolded. 'Clearly you're an action gamer.' is struktured's own line and the beat the scene turns on.

steps.text: Elder Theron stood in the village square, back to the road, addressing a patch of empty cobblestones in the voice of someone who had practised.

lines.speaker: Elder Theron
lines.text: "You'll do." No. Too warm. "You'll... do." Better.

lines.speaker: Elder Theron
lines.text: "The cave to the north. Something's changed in there. The monsters are organized. Deliberate. You need to—"

steps.text: Something small and metal landed on the rim of the well, rolled once, and stopped. It was a crown. It was a very small crown.

lines.speaker: Fighter
lines.text: There was trouble in the cave. We stood in front of it.

lines.speaker: Cleric
lines.text: We would have asked first. Nobody was at the gate to ask.

lines.speaker: Mage
lines.text: The cave was the obvious variable. We tested it.

lines.speaker: Rogue
lines.text: It was never really that heavy.

lines.speaker: Bard
lines.text: We skipped the first act. It's a bold structure. I'm defending it.

lines.speaker: Rogue
lines.text: It was never really that heavy.

lines.speaker: Elder Theron
lines.text: I had a briefing. There were pauses in it. I had decided where to look at each of you, and in what order.

lines.speaker: Elder Theron
lines.text: It is a category. I keep lists. You have just changed lists.

lines.speaker: Elder Theron
lines.text: Fine. You plainly don't need the lesson. Fight however you like, all five of you, by your own hands. Nobody will say I made you ask.

lines.speaker: Elder Theron
lines.text: And if you ever want to know what you skipped, come and find me. The trials are where I left them. Somebody ought to use them.

steps.text: The Elder did not finish the briefing. It was folded, small, and held out instead. In case, said the Elder, of a slower hero.

steps.name: The Unread Briefing
steps.description: Elder Theron's briefing on the menace in the cave, with the pauses marked. Never delivered: you had already dealt with the menace.
